vesper_meet_1.speaker: Vesper
vesper_meet_1.text: You're shedding packets everywhere, Enforcer. Your RES must be under 40%.

vesper_meet_2.speaker: Elias
vesper_meet_2.text: I didn't ask for a diagnostic. I need access to the lower routing layer.

vesper_meet_3.speaker: Vesper
vesper_meet_3.text: I can get you in. But it'll cost you. That Payload you're carrying?

choices.text: No deal. I'll find another way.

vesper_meet_deal.speaker: Vesper
vesper_meet_deal.text: Smart. Let's move before the Sweepers catch up.

vesper_meet_reject.speaker: Vesper
vesper_meet_reject.text: Suit yourself. Enjoy the Bit Rot.
